purpose: Two original same-device discharge records: can interval water, electric energy and date-second labels support limited descriptive observation? No model, effect or capacity estimation.
prior_knowledge: D067 source QA already inspected these two files' basic time/selected field ranges; size/hash, 468/500 data rows, 5s nominal sampling, one unit row, energy zero vs partly nonzero are known. This is deeper disclosed source audit, not blind validation.
selection: All two already acquired FullTankDischarge JSONs. No selection by new errors or output values.
clock: Parse only original %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S. Explicit unit row YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss is retained in flags but excluded from numerical data. Do not sort, fill, add timezone or invent timestamps. Summarize every adjacent original data pair, duplicates, backward steps, gaps and boundary intervals.
field_audit: Inspect all 101 trace fields for length, native type, null/nonfinite, unit/metadata rows, -127, zero, range and counts. Named Boolean fields must be 0/1. Preserve raw and all flags. No residual-based exclusion.
dictionary: Re-read original XLSX read-only and original data paper XML. PowerConsumed=Wh per sample; WaterConsumed=mL per sample; event total=L; flow setpoint=L/min. Match exact raw names to dictionary, no field guessed as actual flow or price.
descriptive: Report original interval energy and interval water in original units, sums with initial sample inclusion explicit, original cumulative water event total and resets, setpoint/state counts and all finite temperature ranges. Compare adjacent event-total differences with same/previous/next sample water only to diagnose measurement alignment; show every offset, never auto-select/shift. Report first/last positive-water rows and all contiguous runs, observed suffix length without asserting recovered state. Per-sample nominal-equivalent W/Lmin = Wh*3600/SamplePeriod and mL*60/(1000*SamplePeriod) are conditional normalization only; neither exact synchronous power nor instrument-calibrated flow.
groups: Each file separately; heating flag; valve state; water positive/zero/invalid; energy positive/zero/invalid. Keep empty groups null, contradictions, missing/sentinel, all extreme cases and last-window censoring.
admission: Require official current file metadata identity and declared license, original dictionary match and full source audit. Permit only per-file published water/electric-energy/state/temperature descriptions and conditional nominal normalizations when valid. No same-row physical heat balance, efficiency, available thermal capacity, human demand/authorization, causal With-vs-NoHeating comparison, command delay or prediction validation.
split: None: source audit and description only, no train/test. Two different dates/initial conditions are not randomized paired interventions.
verification: Second deterministic audit run; independent stdlib raw JSON parser + Decimal sums/datetime clock and pair differences checks across all data rows. Exact counts/hash; numeric absolute tolerance 1e-8 in original units. Frozen D067 model/protocol and all 104 released artifact entries must retain hashes.
stop: Close with limited admission or explicit non-admission and evidence gaps. Do not fit models to two discharge records or modify D067 experiment.
